items.quote: I want this version of it. My people, my health, my body, my business, where I live and everything I have built.
items.statement: I don’t want my old life back. I want this version of it.

items.quote: I want to build every day … to arrive there feeling that’s it’s the best time… not regretting my 40s.

items.quote: How much would I pay to go back to being 26? Or even 36? Honestly? Nothing.
